description: TANC2 expression across GTEx tissues, testing brain enrichment
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
r=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/reference/gene",params={"geneId":"TANC2"},timeout=120).json()
gid=[x for x in r["data"] if x["geneSymbol"]=="TANC2"][0]["gencodeId"]
print("gencodeId:",gid)
g=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
               params={"gencodeId":gid,"datasetId":"gtex_v8","itemsPerPage":100},timeout=120).json()
rows=g.get("data",[])
df=pd.DataFrame([{"tissue":x["tissueSiteDetailId"],"tpm":x["median"]} for x in rows]).sort_values("tpm",ascending=False)
print("n tissues:",len(df))
brain=df[df.tissue.str.startswith("Brain")]
print("\nBrain regions:\n",brain.to_string(index=False))
print("\nMedian TPM across all tissues: %.2f"%df.tpm.median())
print("Brain mean %.2f vs non-brain mean %.2f"%(brain.tpm.mean(),df[~df.tissue.str.startswith("Brain")].tpm.mean()))
from scipy import stats
u=stats.mannwhitneyu(brain.tpm,df[~df.tissue.str.startswith("Brain")].tpm,alternative="greater")
print("Mann-Whitney brain>non-brain: U=%.1f p=%.3g"%(u.statistic,u.pvalue))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,11))
cols=["#c0392b" if t.startswith("Brain") else "#7f8c8d" for t in df.tissue]
ax.barh(range(len(df)),df.tpm,color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(df))); ax.set_yticklabels([t.replace("_"," ") for t in df.tissue],fontsize=7)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("GTEx v8 median TPM")
ax.set_title("TANC2 expression across 54 GTEx tissues (red = brain)",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
